host: Windows x64 MSVC Release, D3D12, RTX 5090; local server/client, 800x600, 120 warmup + 240 measured frames
notes: Ordinary optimized executable, without allocation instrumentation, audio or presentation. Each group ran serially; deterministic camera paths and final readbacks.
Reference projects terrain and TS on the CPU while preserving preceding retained interior work. Terrain-only and shapes-only comparisons independently retain one new path.

Each pair uses the identical executable. The repeated pair adds a datablock self-reinitialization ownership guard; render algorithms are unchanged. Raw provenance and both pairs remain separate below.

Comparison means average the two run means, not the run percentiles. Local simulation and preceding fence waits are included in frame_ms; GPU timestamps and remote-client-only timings are unavailable.
Whole-frame and individual TS gains are modest and subject to run variation. Terrain accounts for most preparation savings. No allocation-free claim is made.
GPU and CPU transformations are not pixel-identical. Reviewed magnified edge crops show isolated coverage/interpolation differences; retain the projected switches for comparisons.
Native memory audit timings are excluded. Requested C++ allocation bytes, process private commit, mapped virtual backing and GPU usage are separate overlapping domains; do not add them.
Live immutable snapshots may exceed cache targets; source debt and incomplete custom-type accounting are explicit. Defaults are not mobile headroom guarantees.

validation.terrain_readbacks: All 32 stitch templates, first-writer morphs, unequal/repeated seams, holes, independent far sphere and haze distances, two camera contexts and software callback policy.
validation.ts_readbacks: 315 lighting/material/depth cases, two prepared lights, optimized point modes, reflected poses, opacity, transparency sorting, trimming and software frozen-lighting snapshots.
validation.lifecycle: Datablock replacement/reset/rollback/self-initialization retains live shape ownership. Twelve fresh RPG1 to RPG5 transition stress processes passed after fixing the discovered stale datablock.
limits: No exhaustive long traversal or mobile pressure/device headroom audit
No GPU timestamps or remote-client-only timing
No full-process allocation-rate instrumentation in ordinary timings
